# MCP tool pages

One page per tool, grouped by area. The parameter table on every page is generated from the live tool catalog, so it always matches what Nova accepts.

Looking for a tool by what it does rather than by area? The [tool catalog](../tool-catalog.md) lists all tools in one place with their parameters.

[MCP reference](../README.md) · [Documentation index](../../README.md)
